title: Minyamin Kandoka, a jar seller
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Chullin 49b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49b.10) relates that his jar of honey was left uncovered, and he came before Rava, etc.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Minyomin Kandoka and says that his jar of honey was left uncovered.

[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2510&lang=en) gives Rashi’s explanation and reports alternative readings from Musaf HeArukh. Hyman abridges the exchange with Rava.
